name: Ship Intake
tagline: From a Slack complaint to a GitHub issue to a fix and a reply in the thread
description: A bug reported in Slack becomes a properly written GitHub issue, gets handed to a Cursor cloud agent for the fix, and the outcome lands back in the original thread so the reporter hears what happened. The loop closes where it started, with a human still reading along. The author's team runs it daily.
author: AnthonyDo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
